lines.text: Color the movie map by originality: how unlike its closest neighbors each plot is.
Audiences rate original moovees higher. From the most crowded fifth to the most original, ratings climb at every step.
But the crowded ones earn twice as much: a median box office of thirty-three million dollars, against sixteen.
And the most original hits are based on true stories: The King's Speech. The Social Network. The Big Short. Hidden Figures.
Follow the money, and superheroes lead: a median of two hundred sixty-eight million dollars a film.
But per dollar spent, James Bond returns five point seven times his budget. Slashers, four times. Political dramas barely break even.
And over seventy years, westerns fell from one film in ten... to one in a hundred, while thrillers more than doubled.
Color the map your way. Massive Movie Map.
